relations.evidence: To select data from a keyspace or expression,, your client must have specific privileges on the keyspace or expression that you want to select from. The required privilege depends on your [cluster access credential type](../../clusters/cluster-rbac.md#cluster-access-credential-types). | Basic | [Read](../../clusters/cluster-rbac.md#basic-access-credentials) |

notable_absence.finding: Unlike DDL statements (CREATE/DROP/GRANT/REVOKE) which gate on management-plane capella-role:* roles, this SELECT/FROM-clause read operator gates purely on the data-plane credential-type privilege pair - no Capella management-plane role is mentioned anywhere on the page. This is consistent with the hypothesis that requiresCapellaRole is specific to statements that alter cluster/security state, while ordinary read operators only carry the credential-type gate.

cross_component_finding: Recurrence of the known issue in docs-issues/capella-pages-cite-server-versions.json: 'In clusters using Couchbase Server 7.6 and later, you can use the LATERAL keyword as a visual reminder that a join contains correlated expressions' - a literal 'Couchbase Server 7.6' version-gate citation on a Capella page describing a SQL++ language feature, despite Capella having no discrete version numbers.
